messages:
alex-cs: Heads-up — we've got a spike of onboarding failures starting ~02:00 UTC. ~12 tenants hit 429s on /v1/tenant/batch_create during bulk imports. Many are high-touch trials; some at risk for renewals. Need quick customer comms + mitigation plan.
priya-cs: How bad is the UX? Are they stuck waiting or retries succeed later? Renewal risk on any >=$10k accounts?
alex-cs: Most imports are stuck (clients retry loop, backoff getting 429 -> gives up). 3 tenants reported webhooks failing too. Affected list in the sheet I'm about to post. Example server log: `HTTP 429: rate_limited - token_quota_exceeded` and a few `503` upstream from embeddings.
toni-eng: Investigating. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler oscillation combined with large synchronous imports caused prefix/KV-cache churn and transient capacity loss. Pushing a soft rate bump and enabling per-tenant isolation. Patch rollout started => ETA 30-45m.
derek-ops: I've queued problematic imports into background worker with lower concurrency for now to reduce pressure. Also kicking off rolling restart of batch workers in eu-west-1 and us-east-1.
alex-cs: Ok — we need two things from CS: (1) a short, clear status update to send to affected tenants in the next 20m, (2) a reconciliation + credit offer for impact. Draft below — please edit.
```
Hi — we're sorry for the disruption. We're currently investigating errors affecting bulk onboarding/imports that can cause import jobs to fail with "rate limit" errors. Our engineers have identified the root cause and are rolling a fix; we expect recovery in the next 45–60 minutes.
What we are doing now: reducing import concurrency, restarting batch workers, and applying temporary rate isolation for affected accounts.
Next steps: we'll follow up with a detailed RCA and a complimentary compensation (account credit) to make this right. If you need hands-on help to complete your import, reply here and we'll prioritize a support session.
— Redwood Inference (CS team)
```
priya-cs: Draft looks good. Suggest adding exact ETA window and a customer-facing contact link. Also propose offering a tailored onboarding session + 15% credit for any migration that failed (to prioritize high-touch).
sarah-cs: I'll triage the impacted list and start outreach for top 6 accounts by ARR. Intercom + direct email + calendar links for support calls. Assigning myself to outreach.
alex-cs: Great. Action items: 
- sarah-cs: outbound to impacted customers (Intercom + email) and schedule priority sessions for top accounts.
- priya-cs: finalize customer message with ETA + contact link and publish within 20m.
- toni-eng: confirm when the patch is in prod and report any residual 429s.
- derek-ops: apply credits once we have final impacted tenant set; handoff to billing for formal credit.
I'll compile an interim status note for execs and prepare an RCA skeleton.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-28345 created and assigned to eng-oncall. Pager duty: toni-eng.
derek-ops: Confirmed credits workflow: we can push provisional credits (internal memo) now and finalize after verification.
toni-eng: Patch is at 50% rollout — early telemetry shows error rate down ~70% for the impacted route. Still watching cache eviction metrics.
alex-cs: Perfect. After we send the status update, collect customer replies and any import logs they provide into the sheet: http://redwood.internal/onboard-incident-28345 — Sarah will own mapping to credits.
sarah-cs: On it. I'll DM legal if anyone raises contract/SLA questions. Will update the thread with outreach snippets and response templates.
priya-cs: I'll prepare the follow-up RCA outline while we monitor. Tentative cause: aggressive simultaneous imports + autoscaler delay + cache eviction leading to token quota exhaustion.
alex-cs: Thanks team — priority to reduce customer-facing noise. I'll send the first batch of messages once Priya posts the edited copy. We'll reconvene here after patch completion for RCA and remediation notes. :thumbsup:
